before_copy.req_109_description_nested_address_14571:
The nested address. On Vercel a catch-all file such as `api/[...path].js` matched only one-segment paths, so
      nested addresses got the host's own 404; the fix is one function app/api/index.js with a rewrite of
      `/api/:path*` (decisions/0116 О4: the lesson learned on another Vercel project and confirmed there by a live
      check on 2026-10-31; its line in docs/program/public-v1/PROGRESS.md, «Log», reaches the repository with the
      records release M0.13; not measured in Sai). ARCH §19.2 writes the rewrite as `/api/(.*)` → `/api`; the form is
      decided by decisions/0116 О4, and spike S1 (M1.2, after G4) confirms it on the owner's project; a correction
      after S1 is a WF-03 defect (PLAN M1.2). The smoke therefore asks a two-segment /api address and fails on any
      answer but the uniform 404 of REQ-108.
